assessment: Approved for experimental release eligibility within this bounded follow-up. The completed historical assessment remains CHANGES_REQUIRED for its original scope; its sole open documentation finding is now corrected. Per-file verification established that all 39 tracked files under src, tests, tools and scripts are unchanged from that assessment. Current source/release identities, 17 execution bundles, retained originals, 346 semantic artifacts, all 24 fixed command/semantic contracts, 51 child-detail bindings and six imported CI original stream sets validate. The certifi correction is supported by retained publisher metadata, wheel bytes, installation streams, installed package/notice checks and preserved before/after advisory findings. No unresolved material issue was demonstrated. The interrupted review attempt was not counted as a completed assessment. This report does not attest future publication or completion of the remaining release operations.

exception.rationale: Exact bytes match the previously assessed exception. It explicitly overrides already-terminal cancellation replay, the completed-result ledger promise and the TH-015 ledger control. Terminal cancellation returns E_NOT_FOUND; cancellation against a reused ID with an old generation returns E_STALE. Lost-response SUBMIT retries can create new work, and controllers must attribute output using session, owner, request ID and generation. Unchanged implementation/tests, current evidence and fresh native checks support preservation of AC-005/007/020/021. Exactly-once delivery is not established.
